div0.head: *k
div0.entryFree:
*kk, ka/ppa, to/, indecl., eleventh (later tenth) letter in Gr. alphabet: as numeral k/ =
20 , but k'
=
20 , 000 . The numeral ka/ ( 21 ) is perh. used as one syll. in a metrical (?) Inscr., IG 12(7).296 (Minoa),
like zh/sasa e)/th e/ , at the end of a hexam. (?), CIG 3025 (Lydia).

ka_, Dor. for Ep. , Aeol.
ke(n),= Att. , Arc.
a)/n, SIG 9 (Olympia, vi B.C.), Epich. 35 ,al., Leg.Gort. 1.9 , Foed.Delph.Pell. 2
A 9 , Ar. Ach. 737 , 799 , Lys. 117 , Th. 5.77 , Theoc. 1.4 . [Although long, the a is elided in Epich. 170.12 ,al., SIG 56.8 (Argos, v B.C.), Leg.Gort. 1.1 , etc.]

ka^, shortd. form of kata/ used before the article,
ka to\n no/mon
IG 5
( 2 ). 16 (Arcadia); ka tw=nnu ib. 262 ; ka tou\s no/mous
SIG 2860.9
(Delph., ii B.C.), etc.; ka ta\ th=s sugklh/tou do/gmata
SIG 705.12
(ibid.) ka ta\ do/canta . . th=| boulh=|
Inscr.Magn. 179.33
(ii A.D.): also in compds., cf. kabai/nwn, etc.
Cypr. ,= ka/s, Inscr.Cypr. 135.5 H., Schwyzer 683.8 .

ka), crasis for kai\ e), i.e. kai\ e)m(
= e)n ), Herod. 2.62 (kh)m corr.m.rec.).

kaarti/as: ba/traxos, Hsch.
ka/auka: peride/raia, plo/kia, Id. (leg. ka/lukas).

kaba/dhs, o(,
military garment named after the Persian king *kaba/dhs, Tz. H. 12.792 .

kabaqa (accent dub.), h(, prob.= Lat.
gabata, dish,
Edict.Diocl. 15.51 : also as neut. pl., kabaqa b/
UPZ 149.40
(iii B.C.); [g]abaqa tri/a Cumont
Fouilles de Doura-EuroposP. 372 No. 13 ; cf. gabaqo/n, za/batos
11
.
ka^bai/nwn, Dor. for katab-, Alcm. 38 .

ka/baisos [a^], o( ,
gluttonous fellow, Cratin. 103 . (Derived by Gramm. fr. ka/bos and ai)=sa and said to be a pr. n.; cf. *ka/baisos
IG 5(2).271.9
(Mantinea, iv B.C.).)

ka^ba/lleion, to/,= sq.,
k. kai\ e)rga/tas dekape/nte
Rev.Arch. 1925.63
(Callatis): kaba/llion, Hsch.

ka^ba/llhs, ou, o(,
nag, Lat.
caballus, Plu. 2.828e ;= e)rga/ths i(/ppos, Hsch. :—hence kaballariko/s, h/, o/n,
of or
for a horse, mu/los
Edict.Diocl. 15.52
; ta/phs
19.22
: kaballa/tion, to/,= kuno/glwsson, Ps. Dsc. 4.127 .
kabac,= panou=rgos, Phot., EM 482.26 , Suid.

*ka/barnos, o(,
priest of Demeter at Paros, IG 12(5).292
(iii A.D.): pl., Hsch. (From *ka/barnis, a poetical name of Paros, St.Byz. )

ka/basa and kaba/sas, both perh. nom. sg., name of an unknown object in temple inventories, Inscr.Délos 298
A 111 , 300
B 16 , IG 11 ( 2 ). 287
B 89 (Delos, iii B.C.). (Perh. fr. *ka/basa in Egypt.)
ka/ba_si [ka^], Lacon. for kata/bhqi, Hsch.

kaba/tas,
= kataiba/ths (q.v.), title of Zeus in Laconia, IG 5(1).1316 (Thalamae).

kabba^liko/s, h/, o/n, Lacon. for katablhtiko/s,
good at throwing, of wrestlers: in Comp.
kabbalikw/teros
Plu. 2.236e
, Gal. Thras. 45 : metaph.,
more ready to trip up one's neighbour, M.Ant. 7.52 : kabbalikh/ (sc. te/xnh), h(,
art of wrestling, Gal. l.c.

kabba/llw, Aeol. for kataba/llw, Alc. 343 ; ka/bbale, Ep. for kate/bale, aor.2 of kataba/llw:—also ka/balen: kate/balen, Hsch.
kabba/s,
v. katabai/nw . kabbasi/a, v. katabasi/a . kabbio/rnous: katesqi/wn, Id. ka/bblhma: peri/strwma ( Lacon. ), Id.

*ka/beiroi [a^], oi( ,
the Cabeiri, divinities worshipped especially in Lemnos, Samothrace, and Boeotia, Pi. Fr. 74b Schr., Hdt. 2.51 , 3.37 , Str. 10.3.15 , etc.; at Miletus, Nic.Dam. 52J. , Milet. (v. infr.), BCH 1.288 ; title of play by Aeschylus, Ath. 10.428f , Sch. Pi. P. 4.303 : sg., *ka/beiros
Pi.
l.c.; freq. in Boeotian Inscrr. (written -bir-), IG 7.2457 , al., cf. AP 6.245 ( Diod. ), Q.S. 1.267 : *kabeiri/des *nu/mfai, and *kabeirw/, h(,
the sisters and
mother of the Cabeiri, Acus. 20J. , Pherecyd. 48
J. :—Adj. *kabeiriko/s, h/, o/n, fem. *kabeiria/s, a/dos, Cabeiric, St. Byz.:—also *kabeirai=os, a, on, Id., Paus. 9.25.8 : *kabeiri/a, h(, epith. of Demeter at *ka/beiroi, Id. 9.25.5 codd.: *kabei/rion, to/,
sanctuary of the C., Id. 9.26.2 ; more correctly *kabei/r[e]ion
IG 11(2).144
A 90
(Delos, iv B.C.): *kabei/ria, ta/,
their mysteries,
Inscr.Perg. 252 , Hsch. :—hence *kabeiria/zomai,
celebrate these mysteries, St.Byz. : *kabi_ria/rxas, o(, IG 7.2428 ( Boeot. ):

*)iwno-arxi/w (
= -e/w ), ib. 2420 . (The spelling *)iwno/-beir- is correct, ib. 11(2) .l.c., Hdn.Gr. 2.411 : the form *)iw/no-bir- is Boeot. (v. supr.) and late Gr., Milet. 6.26
(i A.D.), Alexio and Philox. ap. Et.Gud. 289.30 .) (The connexion with the Semitic root
KBR 'great' (cf. the title *mega/loi *qeoi/) is not certain; nor is that with Skt.
Kúbera- (name of a divinity), fr.
*Kabera-, cf. Patron.
Kāberaká-.)

ka/beios: ne/os (Paph.), Hsch.
ka/bhlos: o( a)peskolumme/nos to\ ai)doi=on, h)\ o)/nos, Id.

kabida/rios, o(,
gem-engraver, Lat.
cabidarius,
Gloss. , Rhetor. in Cat.Cod.Astr. 8(4).216 .
kabita=s, o(, dub. sens. (apptly. a nomen agentis), PLond. 1821.368 .

kable/ei: katapi/nei, Hsch.
kablh/s: ma/ndalos tw=n qurw=n (Paph.), Id.

kabola/, a(,= Dor.
katabolh/, Schwyzer 110g (Argos).

ka/bos, o(, (Hebr.
[kudot ]ab)
corn-measure,= 4
ce/stai, LXX 4 Ki. 6.25 ; f.l. in
Gp. 7.20.1 .

ka/g, poet. form for kata/ before g , ka\g go/nu for kata\ go/nu, Il. 20.458 ;
ka\g go/nwn
Sapph. 44
; ka\g ga=n dub. in SIG 179.9 ( Boeot. , iv B.C.).

kagkai/nw,
parch, dry, Hsch. :—also ka/gkw, metaph. in Pass. , kagkome/nhs: chra=s tw=| fo/bw| (cf. au)=os), Id. (Cf. ke/gkw.)

ka/gkamon, to/,
Bissa Bol, Balsamodendron Katuf, an Arabian gum, Dsc. 1.24 , Plin. HN 12.98 :—also ka/gkalon, to/, Hsch.
ka/gkanon, to/,= kakkali/a (q.v.), Gal. 12.8 , Paul.Aeg. 7.3 .

ka/gka^nos, on, (kagkai/nw)
dry, cu/la k. Il. 21.364 , Od. 18.308 , Theoc. 24.89 ; ka/gkana ka=la
h.Merc. 112
: k. kh=la Epich.in Arch.Pap. 7p.7 ; staxu/s
Lyc. 1430
: kagkale/a: katakekaume/na, Hsch. : kagka/neos, Man. 4.324 .

ka/gkellon me/tron, a system of measures of capacity,
me/trw| tw=| k. a)rta/bas e(/ndeka te/tarton
POxy. 1447
(i A.D.), cf. 133.15
(vi A.D.), etc.

ka/gkelos, o(,= Lat.
cancelli, barrier, starting-gate, in races, Sch. Theoc. 8.57 , Hsch. :—also ka/gkelloi, oi(, IG 7.1681 (Plataea), POxy. 2146.12
(iii A.D.):—whence kagkella/rios, o(, orig.
usher at the (lattice-work) bar of a court, then = logoqe/ths , Lyd. Mag. 3.36 , 37 , PMasp. 5.19 , al. (vi A.D.): ka/gkelon, to/,
bar, tou= dikasthri/ou Sch. Ar. Eq. 641 , 675 : ka/ggellon,
railing, balustrade,
PRyl. 233.4
(ii A.D.): —hence kagkelo-eidw=s, Adv.
like a grating, criss-cross,
Hippiatr. 117 ( v.l. -ll- ):
*)iwno-qu^ri/s, i/dos, h(,= kigkli/s, EM 513.4 :—also kagkelwth\ qu/ra Sch. Ar. V. 124 , Poll. 8.124 ; diaba/qra

entryFree.sense:
furnished with a railing,
PRyl. 233.3
(ii A.D.).

kagku/lh, h(, Aeol. for khki/s, Hsch.
kagra=<s>: katafaga=s (Salam.), Id. (prob.l.).
kagxa/zw, later form for kaxa/zw (q.v.).

kagxa^la/w,
rejoice, exult, kagxalo/wsi . . *)axaioi/, ktl.
rejoice because a Trojan champion has been chosen for his looks, Il. 3.43 ; kagxalo/wn
6.514
, 10.565 ; kagxalo/wsa
Od. 23.1
, 59 ; kagxala/aske
A.R. 4.996
; e)pakth\r kagxalw=n a)greu/mati
Lyc. 109
; kagxala/askon e)tw/sia mhtio/wnti
Q.S. 8.12
; e)ni\ fresi\ -o/wntes kru/bd' *(/hrhs
Id. 3.136
, cf. 200 , al., Opp. C. 4.377 , H. 5.234 ; of hounds, deer, Id. C. 1.523 , 2.237 ; of pards, oi)/nw| me/ga -o/wsi ib. 3.80 ; of a polypus, Id. H. 4.281 .

kagxali/zomai, kagxa/omai,= foreg., Hsch.
ka/gxamos, o(, in Crotoniate dialect,= kisso/s, Id. ka/gxarmon: to\ th\n lo/gxhn a)/nw e)/xein ( Maced. ), Hsch.

kagx-asmo/s, o(,
loud laughter, Poll. 6.199 ; v. kaxasmo/s .

kagx-asth/s, ou=, o(,
loud laugher, Phryn. PS p.78B. , Poll. 6.29 .

kagxla/zw,
= kagxa/zw , Ath. 10.438f , Aq. Jb. 41.23 , Hsch.

kagxru/dion, ka/gxrus, etc.,
v. kaxru/dion, ka/xrus , etc.
ka)gw/ [a_], Att. crasis for kai\ e)gw/.

ka/d, Ep. for kata/ before d
, ka\d dw/mata
Od. 4.72
; k. du/namin
Hes. Op. 336
; before de/, Il. 2.160 , etc.; k. d' e)/bale by tmesis for kate/bale de/, Od. 4.344 .

kada_le/omai, Dor. for katadhle/omai (q.v.). kadali/wn, o(,
one who walks on stilts; and ka/daloi, oi(,
stilts, Hsch.
ka/damos: tuflo/s (Salam.), Id. kadaro/n: qolero/n, Id.

kaddaimone/steros,
= kakod- , Epich. 1 Demiańczuk.

ka/ddion,
v. ka/dion .

ka/ddi^xos, o(, (ka/dos)
jar, ka/ddixos kalei=tai to\ a)ggei=on ei)s o(\ ta\s a)pomagdali/as e)mba/llousi
Plu. Lyc. 12
: hence,
voting-urn, whence kekaddi/xqai,
to be rejected on a vote, ibid.; also, a
measure,= h(mi/ekton, Hsch. , cf. Tab.Heracl. 1.52 , IG 5(1).1447.10 (Messene, iii/ii B.C.):— Lacon.
kadi/kor, Hsch.
s.v. e)ndekadi/kor .

ka/ddos,
= ka/dos (q.v.). kaddra^qe/thn, v. katadarqa/nw . kaddu=sai, Ep. nom. pl. fem. aor. 2 part.
Act. of katadu/w. ka_desth/s, Dor. for khdesth/s. ka/dhs: a(giasmo/s, Hsch.

kadikeu/w, perh.
hold a priesthood, dub. in Rev.Phil. 35.302 (Pharsalus).

ka/d-ion [a^], to/ , Dim. of
ka/dos, IG 11(2).287
A 64 (Delos, iii B.C.), LXX 1 Ki. 17.40 ;= u(dri/a (Salam.), Hsch. (pl.): ka/ddion Sch. D.T. p.195 H.:—also ka/din,
e)/laion kai\ ka/din
Abh.Berl.Akad. 1925(5).31
(Cyrene, ii/iii A.D.).

kad-i/skion, to/, Dim. of sq.,
part of a spice-box, Nicoch. 2 .

kad-i/skos, o(, Dim. of
ka/dos, Cratin. 193 , Stratt. 22 , BCH 35.286
(ii B.C.), Ph. 2.89 , Gal. 11.555 .
voting-urn used in lawcourts, o( de\ k. . . o( me\n a)polu/wn ou(=tos, o( d' a)pollu\s o(di/
Phryn.Com. 32
, cf. Ar. V. 853 , Lys. 13.37 , Lycurg. 149 ; kadi/skwn tetta/rwn teqe/ntwn kata\ to\n no/mon (in a civil cause), D. 43.10 , cf. Is. 11.21 .

kadmei/a (in codd. kadmi/a) (sc. gh=), h(,
cadmia, calamine, Dsc. 5.74 , Gal. 1.413 , al., PTeb. 273.14
(ii/iii A.D.):—written kadmh/a, POxy. 1088.4
(i A.D.).
*kadmei-w=nes, oi(,= *kadmei=oi, Il. 4.385 , etc.

*kadmei-w/nh, h(,
daughter of Cadmus, i.e. Semele, IG 14.1389i59 .

*kadmi=los (on the accent v. Hdn.Gr. 1.162 ), o(, name of one of the Cabiri in Samothrace, St.Byz.
s.v. *kabeiri/a , Hdn.Gr. 2.446 :— also *kasm-, Dionysodor. ap. Sch. A.R. 1.917 , cf. IG 12(8).74 (Imbros, ii A.D.), Call. Fr. 409 ; identified with Hermes, ibid., Hdn.Gr. 1.162 , Sch. Lyc. 162 : with Lat.
camillus (
casm-), Varr. LL 7.3 , cf. Plu. Num. 7 ; *kadmi=loi is prob. for *ka/dwloi, title of ministrants in the cult of the Curetes and *mega/loi *qeoi/, D.H. 2.22 .

*kadmogenh/s, e/s,
Cadmus-born, A. Th. 302 , S. Tr. 116 , E. Ph. 808 (all lyr.).

*ka/dmos, o(, Cadmus, Od. 5.333 , Hes. Th. 937 , etc.:—Adj. *kadmei=os, a, on, lon. *kadmh/ios, h, on, Cadmean, Hes. Th. 940 , etc.:—fem. *kadmhi/s, i/dos, h(, h.Bacch. 57 , Hes. Op. 162 , Th. 1.12 , prob. in Trag.Adesp. 177 :—poet. *kadme/i+os, Pi. I. 3(4).71 , S. Ant. 1115 (lyr.): *kadmei=oi, oi( ,
the Cadmeans or
ancient inhabitants of Thebes, Il. 4.388 , Hes. Th. 326 , Hdt. 5.57 , etc.: *kadmei/a, h( ,
the citadel of Thebes, X. HG 6.3.11 ; also, Pythag. name for
eight,

great victory, Arr. Fr. 21
J. ); so *k. kra/tos
AP 5.178
( Mel. ): metaph., *k. paidei/a
Pl.
l.c.; *k. gra/mmata the alphabet, supposed to have been brought by K. from Phoenicia, Hdt. 5.59 . (The spelling *ka/ssmos is found on a vase of Rhegium, Roscher
Lex.d.Gr.u.Röm.Myth.
2(1).842 .)
ka/dmos: do/ru, lo/fos, a)spi/s (Cret.), Hsch.

ka^dopoio/s, o/n,
making pails or
vessels, Sch. Ar. Pax 1202 .

ka/dos [a^], o( ,
jar or
vessel for water or
wine, Anacr. 17 , Archil. 4 , Hdt. 3.20 , S. Fr. 534.3 (anap.), Ar. Ach. 549 , etc.; k. a)ntlhtiko/s
CPR 232.12
(ii A.D.); said to be Ion. for kera/mion, Clitarch.Gloss. ap. Ath. 11.473b . a liquid measure,= a)mforeu/s, Philoch. 155a ; e)lai/ou

(cod. A), cj. in Simon. 155.4 ( Hermes 64.274 ); pi/nei tetraxo/oisi ka/dois
Hedyl.
ap. Ath.l.c.; later,
half an a)mf., Script. Metrol. 1.257 , 2.144 Hultsch.
= kadi/skos
11 , Ar. Av. 1032 .
funerary urn,
